source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: You ask an agent to fix a reading link. The new link opens a document with the expected title, but two documents share that title. What should you check next?

options.text: Read the destination and compare it with the intended reading.
options.feedback: The title is ambiguous, so content readback is the evidence that can identify the intended document. A successful click alone does not settle the issue.

options.text: Accept the repair because a successful click establishes the right content.
options.feedback: A successful click shows that something opened. It does not distinguish between two documents with the same title.

options.text: Check the operation log for a completed update and accept that as verification.
options.feedback: A log showing an update establishes that an operation was attempted or executed. It does not establish that the saved link reaches the intended content.

options.text: Compare the displayed title again and omit reading either document itself.
options.feedback: Repeating an ambiguous title check cannot resolve which document is linked. The content must be inspected.
